jobs.title: Brand Manager - Brand & Product
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling.

- Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution.

- Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals.

- Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations.

- Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets.

- Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams

- Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives.

- Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment.

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field.

- 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building.

- Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred.

- Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets.

- Experience managing agencies and external creative partners.

Your Essentials

- Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable).

- Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Parte del team di Marketing globale e riportando direttamente al Brand Director, questo ruolo svolge un ruolo centrale nella salvaguardia, nella modellazione e nell'attivazione del marchio Explora Journeys in tutti i punti di contatto, con una particolare attenzione alle campagne di marca, alla flotta e ai nuovi sviluppi del marchio.

Situato nella nostra sede di Ginevra, questo ruolo si trova all'intersezione della strategia di marca, della narrazione dei prodotti e dell'esecuzione, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media e Digital per portare il marchio alla vita con chiarezza, consistenza e profondità emotiva, attraverso i mercati.

Il tuo impatto

Gestione e Governance dei marchi

- Agire come tutore principale del marchio Explora Journeys, supportando il Brand Director nella gestione quotidiana, nello sviluppo e nell'evoluzione del marchio.

- Assicurare l'applicazione coerente di identità di marca, tono di voce, messaggistica e linguaggio visivo in tutti i punti di contatto, canali e viaggi degli ospiti.

- Guida lo sviluppo, l'evoluzione e la manutenzione delle linee guida del marchio, dei framework e dei toolkit master, assicurando rilevanza, chiarezza e scalabilità a livello globale.

- Monitorare l'esecuzione del marchio su mercati e partner, identificare proattivamente le incongruenze e lavorare in collaborazione con gli stakeholder per salvaguardare gli standard di lusso e ospitalità.

- Contribuisci a iniziative di strategia di marca, progetti di evoluzione del marchio e formazione interna del marchio, rafforzare la comprensione e l'allineamento del marchio in tutta l'organizzazione.

Campagne, contenuti e attività di marca

- Condurre lo sviluppo e la consegna di campagne di marca e prodotto master, in linea con la strategia di marca e priorità commerciali.

- Superare la creazione di eroi e beni di prodotto, tra cui visivi chiave, quadri di copia, brochure, fotografia e videografia.

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Media, Digital e PR per garantire un'espressione coerente e premium del marchio attraverso canali pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati.

- Gestisci e cura i contenuti del marchio, del prodotto e della flotta all'interno dei sistemi DAM e PIM, garantendo precisione, facilità d'uso e adozione del mercato globale.

Marketing del prodotto – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Possedere e articolare la narrazione del marchio e del prodotto per la flotta di Explora Journeys, traducendo il design delle navi, le esperienze a bordo e la filosofia di servizio in avvincente, chiaro, e guest-centric storytelling.

- Agire come partner chiave del marchio per i team di Product, New Builds e Hotel Operations, supportando progetti in tutto il ciclo di vita della nave; dal concetto iniziale alla consegna, al lancio e all'evoluzione in-service.

- Definire e attivare proposizioni e concetti a livello di nave, esperienze a bordo, concetti suite, pilastri culinari, benessere e vendita al dettaglio, e rituali di servizio.

- Assicurare l'allineamento tra l'esperienza ospite a bordo e la promessa del marchio comunicata al mercato.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Supporto del marchio e prontezza del prodotto per nuove iniziative di marca, campagne, lanci delle navi, grandi pietre miliari e innovazioni a bordo.

- Sviluppare strumenti di lancio master per dotare canali, mercati, vendite e PR con chiare narrazioni, posizionamento e attività.

- Assicurare coerenza, chiarezza e allineamento del marchio in tutte le comunicazioni interne ed esterne relative al marchio, alla flotta e all'evoluzione del prodotto.

Collaborazione funzionale e eccellenza operativa

- Agire come partner di marca affidabile attraverso le funzioni, favorendo l'allineamento tra brand, prodotto, commerciale e team operativi

- Coordinate budget, fornitori, previsioni, ordini di acquisto e fatturazione relative a iniziative di marca.

- Bilanciare il marchio strategico pensando con le mani sull'esecuzione in un ambiente veloce.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea magistrale in Marketing, Gestione del marchio, Marketing del prodotto, o un campo relativo.

- 8+ anni di esperienza nella gestione del marchio e nella costruzione di campagne.

- Esperienza prioritaria all'interno di lusso, premium o high-end di viaggio, ospitalità o marchi di consumatori fortemente preferito.

- Esperienza comprovata che opera in un ambiente di quartier generale globale, gestione dei quadri di marca e dei beni master in tutti i mercati.

- Esperienza di agenzie di gestione e partner creativi esterni.

I tuoi essenziali

- Esposizione al marketing del prodotto e prodotti basati sull'esperienza fisica (ships, hotel, resort, o ambienti premium complessi altamente desiderabili).

- Forte sensibilità creativa combinata con rigore operativo, attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder.

- Comodo spostamento tra pensiero strategico del marchio e esecuzione dettagliata.

- Fluente in inglese; lingue europee aggiuntive sono un forte vantaggio.

A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia.
Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare.
Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

Dein Zweck

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorgestellt wird. Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (vier derzeit in der Pipeline) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht.

Als Teil des globalen Marketingteams und direkter Berichterstattung an den Brand Director spielt diese Rolle eine zentrale Rolle bei der Sicherung, Gestaltung und Aktivierung der Marke Explora Journeys über alle Touchpoints hinweg, mit besonderem Fokus auf Markenkampagnen, die Flotte und neue Markenentwicklungen.

Mit Sitz in unserem Hauptsitz in Genf befindet sich diese Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Markenstrategie, Produkt-Storytelling und Ausführung und arbeitet eng mit Produkt-, Design-, Hotelbetrieb-, Handels-, PR-, Medien- und Digitalteams zusammen, um die Marke marktübergreifend klar, konsistent und emotional zum Leben zu erwecken.

Ihre Wirkung

Brand Management & Governance

- Handeln Sie als zentraler Hüter der Marke Explora Journeys und unterstützen Sie den Brand Director bei der täglichen Verwaltung, Entwicklung und Entwicklung der Marke.

- Gewährleistung einer konsistenten Anwendung von Markenidentität, Tonfall, Messaging und visueller Sprache über alle Touchpoints, Kanäle und Gästereisen hinweg.

- Führen Sie die Entwicklung, Weiterentwicklung und Pflege von Markenrichtlinien, Frameworks und Master-Toolkits, um Relevanz, Klarheit und Skalierbarkeit weltweit zu gewährleisten.

- Überwachen Sie die Markenausführung über Märkte und Partner hinweg, identifizieren Sie proaktiv Inkonsistenzen und arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern zusammen, um Luxus- und Gastfreundschaftsstandards zu gewährleisten.

- Tragen Sie zu Markenstrategieinitiativen, Markenentwicklungsprojekten und interner Markenbildung bei und stärken Sie das Markenverständnis und die Ausrichtung im gesamten Unternehmen.

Kampagnen, Content & Brand Aktivierung

- Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Master-Marken- und Produktkampagnen im Einklang mit Markenstrategie und kommerziellen Prioritäten.

- Beaufsichtigen Sie die Erstellung von Helden-Marken- und Produkt-Assets, einschließlich Key Visuals, Copy-Frameworks, Broschüren, Fotografie und Videografie.

- Arbeiten Sie eng mit Medien-, Digital- und PR-Teams zusammen, um einen kohärenten und erstklassigen Markenausdruck über bezahlte, besessene und verdiente Kanäle hinweg sicherzustellen.

- Verwalten und kuratieren Sie Marken-, Produkt- und Flotteninhalte in DAM- und PIM-Systemen, um Genauigkeit, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und globale Marktakzeptanz zu gewährleisten.

Produktmarketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Besitzen und artikulieren Sie die Marken- und Produkterzählung für die Explora Journeys-Flotte und übersetzen Sie Schiffsdesign, Onboard-Erfahrungen und Servicephilosophie in überzeugendes, klares und gastzentriertes Storytelling.

- Handeln Sie als wichtiger Markenpartner für Produkt-, Neubau- und Hotelbetriebsteams und unterstützen Sie Projekte während des gesamten Schiffslebenszyklus; von der frühen Konzeption über die Lieferung, den Start und die Entwicklung im Betrieb.

- Definieren und aktivieren Sie Vorschläge und Konzepte auf Schiffsebene, Onboard-Erlebnisse, Suite-Konzepte, kulinarische, Wellness- und Einzelhandelssäulen und Service-Rituale.

- Gewährleistung der Abstimmung zwischen dem Gästeerlebnis an Bord und dem dem Markt mitgeteilten Markenversprechen.

Launch & Go to Market Koordination

- Unterstützung der Marken- und Produktbereitschaft für neue Markeninitiativen, Kampagnen, Schiffsstarts, wichtige Meilensteine und Innovationen an Bord.

- Entwickeln Sie Master-Launch-Toolkits, um Kanäle, Märkte, Vertrieb und PR mit klaren Erzählungen, Positionierung und Vermögenswerten auszustatten.

- Gewährleistung von Konsistenz, Klarheit und Markenausrichtung in allen internen und externen Kommunikationen im Zusammenhang mit Marken-, Flotten- und Produktentwicklung.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Markenpartner in allen Funktionen und fördern Sie die Ausrichtung zwischen Marken-, Produkt-, Handels- und Betriebsteams

- Koordinieren Sie Budgets, Lieferanten, Prognosen, Bestellungen und Rechnungsstellung im Zusammenhang mit Markeninitiativen.

- Balancieren Sie strategisches Markendenken mit der praktischen Umsetzung in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld.

Deine Reise bisher

- Master-Abschluss in Marketing, Markenmanagement, Produktmarketing oder einem verwandten Bereich.

- 8+ Jahre Erfahrung im Markenmanagement und Kampagnenaufbau.

- Vorkenntnisse in Luxus-, Premium- oder High-End-Reise-, Hospitality- oder Verbrauchermarken wurden stark bevorzugt.

- Bewährte Erfahrung in einer globalen Zentralumgebung, Verwaltung von Marken-Frameworks und Master Assets in allen Märkten.

- Erleben Sie Managing Agenturen und externe Kreativpartner.

Ihre Essentials

- Exposition gegenüber Produktmarketing und physischen erfahrungsbasierten Produkten (Schiffe, Hotels, Resorts oder komplexe Premium-Umgebungen, die sehr wünschenswert sind).

- Starke kreative Sensibilität kombiniert mit operativer Strenge, Liebe zum Detail und Fähigkeiten des Stakeholder-Managements.

- Komfortabler Wechsel zwischen strategischem Markendenken und detaillierter Ausführung.

- Fließend Englisch; zusätzliche europäische Sprachen sind ein großer Vorteil.

Faisant partie de l'équipe mondiale du marketing et relevant directement du directeur de la marque, ce rôle joue un rôle central dans la sauvegarde, l'élaboration et l'activation de la marque Explora Journeys sur tous les points de contact, en mettant l'accent sur les campagnes de marque, la flotte et les nouveaux développements de la marque.

Basé à notre siège social à Genève, ce rôle se situe à l'intersection de la stratégie de la marque, du conte de produits et de l'exécution, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media et Digital pour donner vie à la marque avec clarté, cohérence et profondeur émotionnelle, sur les marchés.

Votre impact

Gestion et gouvernance de la marque

- Agir en tant que gardienne principale de la marque Explora Journeys, en soutenant le directeur de la marque dans la gestion quotidienne, le développement et l'évolution de la marque.

- Assurer une application uniforme de l'identité de la marque, du ton de la voix, de la messagerie et du langage visuel sur tous les points de contact, canaux et voyages des invités.

- Diriger l'élaboration, l'évolution et la mise à jour des lignes directrices, des cadres et des trousses d'outils, en assurant la pertinence, la clarté et l'évolutivité à l'échelle mondiale.

- Surveiller l'exécution de la marque à travers les marchés et les partenaires, identifier proactivement les incohérences et travailler en collaboration avec les intervenants pour protéger les normes de luxe et d'accueil.

- Contribuer aux initiatives de stratégie de marque, aux projets d'évolution de la marque et à l'éducation interne de la marque, en renforçant la compréhension et l'alignement de la marque dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Campagnes, contenu et activation de la marque

- Diriger l'élaboration et la livraison de campagnes de marques et de produits, conformément à la stratégie de la marque et aux priorités commerciales.

- Superviser la création d'actifs de marque et de produit héros, y compris les visuels clés, les cadres de copie, les brochures, la photographie et la vidéographie.

- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes des médias, du numérique et des relations publiques afin d'assurer une expression cohérente et haut de gamme de la marque sur les canaux payants, possédés et gagnés.

- Gérer et guérir le contenu de la marque, du produit et de la flotte au sein des systèmes DAM et PIM, en assurant la précision, la facilité d'utilisation et l'adoption du marché mondial.

Marketing de produits – Flotte et expérience à bord

- Propre et articuler le récit de la marque et du produit pour la flotte Explora Journeys, traduisant la conception du navire, les expériences à bord et la philosophie de service en récits convaincants, clairs et centrés sur les invités.

- Agir en tant que partenaire de marque clé des équipes Product, New Builds et Hotel Operations, en soutenant des projets tout au long du cycle de vie du navire; du concept précoce à la livraison, au lancement et à l'évolution en service.

- Définir et activer des propositions et des concepts de niveau navire, des expériences à bord, des concepts de suite, des piliers culinaires, de bien-être et de détail, et des rituels de service.

- Assurer l'alignement entre l'expérience des invités embarqués et la promesse de marque communiquée au marché.

Lancement & Aller à la coordination du marché

- Appuyer la préparation des marques et des produits aux nouvelles initiatives, aux campagnes, aux lancements de navires, aux grandes étapes et aux innovations à bord.

- Élaborer des trousses de lancement pour équiper les canaux, les marchés, les ventes et les relations publiques de récits, de positionnements et d'actifs clairs.

- Assurer l'uniformité, la clarté et l'alignement de la marque dans toutes les communications internes et externes liées à l'évolution de la marque, de la flotte et du produit.

Collaboration transfonctionnelle et excellence opérationnelle

- Agir en tant que partenaire de marque de confiance dans toutes les fonctions, en favorisant l'alignement entre les équipes de marque, de produit, commerciale et opérationnelle

- Coordonner les budgets, les fournisseurs, les prévisions, les bons de commande et la facturation liés aux initiatives de marque.

- Équilibrez la pensée stratégique de marque avec l'exécution mains sur mains dans un environnement à rythme rapide.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Maîtrise en marketing, gestion de marques, marketing de produits ou un domaine connexe.

- 8+ ans d'expérience dans la gestion de la marque et la construction de campagnes.

- Expérience antérieure dans le luxe, les voyages haut de gamme, l'hospitalité ou les marques de consommateurs fortement préféré.

- Expérience éprouvée dans un environnement mondial de siège, gestion des cadres de marques et maîtrise des actifs sur les marchés.

- Expérience des agences de gestion et des partenaires créatifs externes.

Vos essentiels

- Exposition à la commercialisation de produits et à des produits basés sur l'expérience physique (navires, hôtels, stations balnéaires ou environnements complexes haut de gamme hautement souhaitables).

- Une forte sensibilité créative associée à la rigueur opérationnelle, à l'attention accordée aux détails et aux compétences en gestion des intervenants.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

titleByLocale.en: Head of Product Category, Watches & Jewellery

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Head of Watches & Jewelry Product Category is the global business owner for the Watches & Jewelry category across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role is responsible for defining and executing the global category strategy, driving commercial performance, developing a world-class assortment, and building long-term partnerships with leading watch and jewelry maisons.

Working closely with Retail Operations, Planning & Budget, and Supply Chain, this role ensures the category delivers exceptional guest experiences while maximizing sales, profitability and brand equity across all ships.

The position combines strategic category management with strong commercial leadership to continuously elevate the onboard retail offering across both contemporary and luxury environments.

Your Impact

Category Strategy & Business Ownership

- Own the global Watches & Jewelry category strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Define the long-term category vision aligned with the commercial objectives and positioning of each cruise brand.

- Identify emerging trends, market opportunities and guest expectations to continuously evolve the category.

- Build a balanced portfolio across fine jewelry, fashion jewelry, luxury watches, contemporary watches and exclusive collections.

- Develop category roadmaps supporting future fleet expansion, new concepts and new brand introductions.

Commercial Performance

- Deliver category sales, gross margin and profitability targets.

- Monitor category performance through KPI analysis, identifying opportunities and corrective actions.

- Optimize product mix, pricing architecture, promotional activities and inventory productivity.

- Lead forecasting and assortment planning in collaboration with Demand Planning and Order Management teams.

- Drive continuous improvement of productivity per SKU, per brand, per boutique and per vessel.

Product Development & Assortment Management

- Curate compelling assortments adapted to guest demographics, regions, itineraries and ship profiles.

- Develop exclusive products, capsule collections and cruise-only editions with strategic partners.

- Manage the full product lifecycle from selection and onboarding to phase-out.

- Ensure assortment reflects market trends while preserving a coherent brand architecture.

- Balance innovation with proven commercial performers.

Brand Partnerships

- Develop and manage relationships with global watch and jewelry brands.

- Lead commercial negotiations including trading terms, exclusivities, product launches and joint business plans.

- Identify and onboard new brands aligned with the Group retail strategy.

- Coordinate supplier performance reviews and continuous business development initiatives.

- Represent MSC Group during industry events, trade fairs and partner meetings.

Merchandising & Retail Excellence

- Define merchandising guidelines specific to the Watches & Jewelry category.

- Collaborate with Visual Merchandising to create premium boutique experiences that enhance conversion and storytelling.

- Support newbuilds, refurbishments and boutique redesigns from a category perspective.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury brand standards and visual excellence.

- Partner with onboard teams to continuously improve category execution.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Watches & Jewelry merchandising team.

- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and commercial excellence.

- Coach team members and support succession planning.

- Encourage data-driven decision making while maintaining strong customer and brand focus.

Your Journey so far

- 10+ years of experience in luxury watches and/or jewelry merchandising.

- Proven success managing international product categories within luxury retail, travel retail or omnichannel environments.

- Strong experience in assortment planning, buying, supplier negotiations and category management.

- Experience working with internationally recognized watch and jewelry brands.

- Experience in luxury retail or travel retail environments is highly desirable

Your Essentials

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping the customer journey and guest experience aboard our new ships?

We are looking for a Newbuild Experience Development & Delivery Manager to join our team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Experience Development & Delivery.

This role is designed for someone who can cut through complexity, uncover the real challenges behind ambiguous situations, and reframe them into guest-centric experiences that can be brought to life within the physical environment of our ships. You are able to connect customer needs, operational realities, and business objectives, transforming ideas into clear, actionable concepts and deliverables.

Working closely with stakeholders across Hotel Operations, F&B, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Architecture, and Design, you will help define, develop, and deliver future guest experiences from concept through execution. You will ensure that every solution is insight-driven, operationally feasible, and aligned with our brand vision and strategic objectives.

Success in this role requires strong understanding of the customer journey, intellectual curiosity, and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively. You are a trusted partner who can influence diverse stakeholders, elevate the quality of thinking around you, and bring clarity, structure, and momentum to complex projects.

Your Impact

Project Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation.

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for înternal conversations.

Narrative Building & Deliverables Presentation

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums (on Canva, PowerPoint of other design tools).

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Hotel Operations, F&B, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Architects, and Designers teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

- Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

- EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

jobs.title: Senior Category Manager, Watch
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Senior Watch Merchandiser is responsible for developing and executing the global watch assortment across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

Working closely with the Head of Watches & Jewelry, the role ensures that the assortment reflects guest expectations, market trends and brand positioning while maximizing commercial performance across the fleet.

The position combines deep product expertise with strong analytical capabilities to optimize assortment architecture, product lifecycle, inventory productivity and in-store presentation. Acting as the product expert for the watch category, the Senior Watch Merchandiser collaborates with leading watch maisons and cross-functional teams to deliver an exceptional onboard retail experience.

Your Impact

Product Assortment Management

- Build and maintain the global watch assortment across all cruise brands and ship classes.

- Develop balanced assortments across luxury, premium and contemporary watch brands.

- Continuously review product performance to optimize assortment productivity.

- Recommend new references, discontinue underperforming products and manage product lifecycle.

- Ensure product architecture reflects guest demographics, itineraries and retail concepts.

Product Expertise

- Act as the internal expert for the global watch category.

- Maintain in-depth knowledge of brands, collections, complications, movements, materials and industry innovations.

- Monitor global watch trends, competitive landscape and consumer preferences.

- Support the introduction of new collections and exclusive products.

- Provide recommendations based on commercial opportunities and market intelligence.

Merchandising & Commercial Performance

- Analyse sales performance, sell-through, inventory productivity and assortment efficiency.

- Support pricing reviews, promotional activities and commercial initiatives.

- Monitor KPI performance by SKU, brand, boutique and vessel.

- Identify opportunities to improve conversion, average transaction value and category productivity.

- Prepare regular business reviews and performance reports.

Supplier & Brand Coordination

- Maintain day-to-day relationships with watch suppliers and brand representatives.

- Coordinate product launches, allocations, deliveries and assortment updates.

- Ensure product information, technical specifications and commercial documentation remain accurate.

- Support supplier meetings, business reviews and brand presentations.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Product Data & Systems

- Maintain product master data, assortment files and merchandising tools.

- Ensure accuracy of product attributes, pricing, imagery and product descriptions.

- Support seasonal assortment reviews and product planning processes.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of merchandising processes and reporting.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years of experience in luxury watch merchandising, buying or category management.

- Strong knowledge of the Swiss watch industry and international luxury brands.

- Experience in luxury retail, travel retail or department stores.

- Proven analytical skills and experience working with merchandising and reporting tools.

- Experience working with ERP and merchandise planning systems.

Your Essentials

- Passion for luxury watches and strong product knowledge.

- Excellent analytical and numerical skills.

- Strong understanding of merchandising principles and assortment planning.

- Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in an international environment.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and merchandising systems.

- Fluent English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally when required.

jobs.title: Jewellery Product Development Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Jewelry Product Development Senior Manager is responsible for transforming creative concepts into commercially successful jewelry collections across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys. Working closely with the in-house Jewelry Designer, the Head of Watches & Jewelry, industrial partners and suppliers, the role leads the end-to-end product development process from concept validation through industrialization and market launch while ensuring each collection is commercially balanced, technically feasible, financially viable and aligned with the positioning of each cruise brand. The role combines creativity, product expertise and industrial know-how to build distinctive jewelry collections that strengthen the Group's exclusive retail offering.

Your Impact

Collection Development

- Lead the end to end development of exclusive jewelry collections from concept to launch.

- Translate creative vision into commercially successful products while preserving design integrity.

- Build structured collections with balanced product architecture, pricing, materials, and customer segments.

- Identify portfolio gaps and propose new product opportunities.

- Maintain collection freshness through seasonal updates, new launches, and limited editions.

Product Development

- Manage the product development calendar and critical path.

- Coordinate prototypes, technical drawings, sampling, approvals, and production readiness.

- Ensure products meet quality, cost, timing, and commercial targets.

- Monitor product performance throughout its lifecycle and drive improvements.

- Support collection launches across the network.

Supplier & Industrial Partner Management

- Manage relationships with jewelry manufacturers and production partners.

- Identify and onboard new suppliers to support growth and innovation.

- Evaluate suppliers based on quality, craftsmanship, innovation, capacity, ethical sourcing, and competitiveness.

- Facilitate technical collaboration between designers and manufacturers.

- Support supplier negotiations with Category Management and Procurement.

Collection Architecture & Portfolio Management

- Continuously assess the strength and completeness of the jewelry portfolio.

- Maintain balanced representation across categories, materials, gemstones, finishes, and price points.

- Analyze sales and customer insights to identify assortment opportunities.

- Recommend portfolio rationalization to improve productivity.

- Develop long term collection roadmaps aligned with brand strategy.

Quality & Product Excellence

- Ensure all products meet quality, regulatory, and brand standards.

- Coordinate testing, validation, and production approvals.

- Partner with Quality teams to resolve issues and improve product performance.

- Maintain exceptional craftsmanship across all collections.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner with the Jewelry Designer throughout the creative process.

- Align product development with category strategy alongside the Head of Watches & Jewelry.

- Collaborate with Retail Operations to maximize commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to optimize inventory levels.

- Partner with Performance teams to monitor profitability and investment returns.

- Coordinate effectively with cross functional stakeholders to ensure alignment and execution.

Innovation

- Monitor jewelry trends, materials, manufacturing techniques, and consumer preferences.

- Explore new materials, gemstones, finishes, and production technologies.

- Benchmark competitors and identify differentiation opportunities.

- Drive innovation while maintaining commercial and operational viability.

Your Journey so far

- 8+ years of experience in jewelry product development, collection management or product management.

- Experience working with jewelry manufacturers and production partners.

- Strong understanding of jewelry manufacturing processes, materials and craftsmanship.

- Experience managing product development calendars and supplier coordination.

- Experience within luxury jewelry is highly desirable.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of jewelry product development from concept to production.

- Strong knowledge of manufacturing techniques, materials and quality standards.

- Excellent project management and organizational skills.

- Commercial awareness with the ability to balance creativity and profitability.

- Strong analytical skills and understanding of collection architecture.

- Excellent communication and relationship management capabilities.

- Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders across creative, technical and commercial functions.

- Passion for luxury jewelry and product innovation.

- Willingness to travel internationally to suppliers and manufacturing partners.

jobs.title: Marketing Full Funnel Analyst
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

- The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.
Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Develop attribution models (e.g.  media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency.

- Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of marketing measurement methodologies including attribution modelling, media mix modelling, customer segmentation, and ROI analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.title: Retail Business Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Business Analytics Manager is responsible for transforming retail data into actionable business insights that improve commercial performance, inventory productivity and decision-making across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role provides analytical leadership across sales performance, profitability, demand planning, inventory optimization and commercial governance.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

The position acts as a strategic business partner, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement across all retail categories

Your Impact

Business Performance Analytics

- Develop and maintain retail performance dashboards covering sales, margin, inventory and productivity indicators.

- Provide regular performance analysis by:

- Ship

- Boutique

- Category

- Brand

- SK

- Itinerary

- Guest segment

- Identify commercial opportunities and performance gaps.

- Translate data into clear recommendations and action plans for Retail Leadership and Category teams.

KPI Framework & Reporting

- Define and improve the global retail KPI framework, including:

- Sales performance

- Conversion rate

- Average Transaction Value (ATV)

- Units Per Transaction (UPT)

- Sales per square meter / selling space

- Sell-through

- Gross margin

- Inventory productivity

- Stock turn

- Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.

- Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.

Demand & Inventory Analytics

- Support demand forecasting by SKU, ship, boutique and geographic area.

- Analyze sales trends, seasonality, itinerary impact and guest behavior to improve forecasts.

- Identify best sellers, slow movers and inventory risks.

- Provide recommendations for:

- Allocation

- Replenishment

- Stock balancing

- Inventory optimization

- Support stock shortage prevention and opportunity capture.

Commercial Control & Profitability

- Monitor margin performance and identify improvement opportunities.

- Support pricing validation and pricing consistency across categories.

- Analyze promotional performance and markdown effectiveness.

- Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.

- Evaluate profitability by:

- Product

Assortment & Category Insights

- Provide analytical support to Category Managers for assortment decisions.

- Analyze:

- Product productivity

- SKU contribution

- Collection performance

- Brand performance

- Price architecture

- Identify opportunities to improve assortment depth and efficiency.

- Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.

- Monitor inventory health across the fleet.

- Identify:

- Overstock situations

- Stock shortages

- Obsolete inventory

- Low productivity products

- Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.

- Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.

Data Management & Tools

- Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.

- Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.

- Contribute to the transition from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated analytics.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with:

- Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics

- Category Managers

- Retail Operations

- Merchandise Planning

- Finance

- Supply Chain

- IT / Digital teams

- Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions

Your Journey so far

- 5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.

- Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.

- Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.

- Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.

- Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.

Your Essentials

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills.

- Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.

- Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

- Strong understanding of inventory management and merchandise planning principles.

- Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).

- Strong communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders.

- Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.

- Ability to work in a fast-moving international environment.

- Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

jobs.title: Visual Merchandising Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

- The Visual Merchandising Manager is responsible for defining, implementing and continuously elevating the visual merchandising standards across all onboard retail environments of MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- The role ensures that every boutique delivers a premium and consistent guest experience while respecting the identity of each cruise brand and the visual standards of the world's leading luxury and premium brands.

- With a particular focus on Fashion & Accessories, the role also coordinates the visual execution of Watches & Jewelry and Beauty & Duty Free boutiques in close collaboration with brand partners and Category teams.

- Working across HQ functions, onboard retail teams, architects, designers and luxury maisons, the Visual Merchandising Manager transforms commercial strategies into inspiring retail environments that maximize customer engagement and commercial performance.

Your Impact

Global Visual Merchandising Strategy

- Develop and continuously evolve the global visual merchandising strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Establish visual standards that reflect the positioning of each cruise brand while maintaining commercial effectiveness.

- Ensure consistency of visual execution across the global fleet.

- Develop seasonal visual merchandising calendars supporting commercial initiatives and product launches.

- Create scalable visual standards adaptable to different ship classes and boutique formats.

Fashion & Accessories Visual Leadership

- Lead all visual merchandising activities for Fashion & Accessories boutiques.

- Develop display concepts that enhance product storytelling and elevate the guest shopping experience.

- Optimize product presentation to improve visibility, conversion and average transaction value.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury retail best practices while adapting to operational realities onboard.

Watches, Jewelry & Beauty Coordination

- Coordinate with luxury watch, jewelry and beauty brands to ensure visual execution complies with brand guidelines.

- Manage the implementation of brand display furniture, point-of-sale materials, animations and seasonal campaigns.

- Coordinate installation of showcases, displays and branded environments during new openings and refurbishments.

- Act as the primary visual merchandising contact for supplier visual teams.

Retail Experience & Guest Journey

- Develop immersive retail experiences that encourage product discovery and storytelling.

- Ensure visual merchandising supports the overall guest journey across all retail spaces.

- Collaborate with Marketing to translate campaigns into engaging in-store experiences.

- Promote experiential retail through animations, pop-ups, product launches and seasonal activations.

Newbuilds & Boutique Development

- Support retail design for new ships, refurbishments and dry docks.

- Collaborate with architects, designers and Category teams to optimize store layouts and product presentation.

- Recommend fixtures, furniture, lighting, materials and display solutions aligned with luxury retail standards.

- Participate in boutique commissioning and opening preparations.

Brand Standards & Governance

- Develop and maintain the Global Visual Merchandising Guidelines.

- Conduct regular fleet audits to ensure compliance with visual standards.

- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through performance analysis and guest feedback.

- Maintain strong relationships with visual merchandising teams from luxury brand partners.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal VM material delivery.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Visual Merchandising function across the organization.

- Inspire a culture of creativity, attention to detail and luxury excellence.

- Coach onboard visual champions and retail teams on visual merchandising best practices.

- Promote innovation while ensuring operational simplicity and executional consistency.

Your Journey so far

- 8+ years of experience in Visual Merchandising within luxury fashion, premium retail or travel retail.

- Strong experience working with internationally recognized luxury and premium brands.

- Experience developing visual merchandising standards across multiple stores or international markets.

- Experience supporting new store openings and retail concept development.

- Experience in luxury department stores, fashion retail or travel retail is highly desirable.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury visual merchandising principles and premium customer experience.

- Strong aesthetic sensitivity combined with commercial awareness.

- Excellent knowledge of fashion presentation, styling and luxury retail codes.

- Experience collaborating with luxury brands and managing brand visual guidelines.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

- Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.

- Creative mindset supported by strong execution capabilities.

- Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels regularly.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery is responsible for bringing the next generation of guest experiences to life across MSC Cruises' new class of ships.
Working closely with the Product Innovation team, this role transforms approved concepts into fully realized onboard experiences, ensuring they are operationally executable, commercially successful, and aligned with the MSC Cruises brand.
Leading the development and delivery of end-to-end guest journeys, service concepts, and onboard experiences, the Sr. Director ensures every experience is launch-ready from ship design and operational planning to crew delivery and guest activation.
The role also plays a key part in defining how new experiences are presented to guests, partnering with internal teams to shape compelling storytelling, positioning, and go-to-market strategies that maximize guest engagement and commercial impact.
As a trusted partner to senior leadership, the Sr. Director regularly presents progress, recommendations, and delivery strategies to executive stakeholders, including the CEO and Chairman, ensuring alignment from concept approval through successful launch.

Your Impact

Experience Development & Delivery

-
Lead the end-to-end development and delivery of new guest experiences, from approved concept through ship launch.

-
Translate approved concepts into guest journeys, service models, operational requirements, and launch plans.

-
Ensure every experience remains true to the original vision while being operationally feasible, commercially successful, and aligned with MSC Cruises' brand standards.

Guest Experience Excellence

-
Champion guest-centric experiences that combine hospitality, storytelling, service excellence, and commercial performance.

-
Design memorable end-to-end guest journeys that create emotional engagement and enhance guest satisfaction.

-
Apply industry best practices and continuous innovation to elevate onboard experiences across the fleet.

Cross-Functional Leadership

-
Lead collaboration across Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architects, designers, and external partners to successfully deliver new guest experiences.

-
Ensure alignment between ship design, construction milestones, operational readiness, and launch activities.

-
Manage stakeholder expectations, priorities, risks, dependencies, and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Project & Delivery Management

-
Oversee project plans, budgets, timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.

-
Support the SVP with budget oversight, executive reporting, strategic recommendations, and delivery governance.

-
Ensure projects are properly planned, resourced, and delivered on time, within scope, and in line with business objectives.

Executive Communication

-
Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and project updates for senior leadership, including the CEO and Chairman.

-
Clearly communicate delivery progress, key decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations.

-
Support executive decision-making with data-driven insights, operational considerations, and guest experience perspectives.

Team Leadership

-
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of guest experience professionals.

-
Build capabilities in guest journey design, hospitality delivery, stakeholder management, project execution, and operational integration.

-
Foster a collaborative, accountable, innovative, and guest-first culture while developing future leadership talent.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

-
Define, monitor, and report KPIs related to launch readiness, guest satisfaction, operational adoption, experience quality, and commercial performance.

-
Lead post-launch evaluations, capture lessons learned, and implement continuous improvements to strengthen future experience delivery.

-
Drive a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across all guest experience development activities.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

- 12+ years of experience in designing and delivering physical, in-space guest experiences within hospitality, cruise ships, resorts, themed entertainment, or similar service-driven environments, with a clear focus on onboard or on-site experiences rather than digital products.

- Proven track record of leading large-scale, guest-facing physical experience projects from concept through implementation in complex operational environments such as ships, hotels, or resorts.

- Strong understanding of physical guest experience design, hospitality operations, service excellence, and in-person customer journey development within built environments.

- Demonstrated ability to translate strategic concepts into operationally executable, tangible experiences and launch plans within physical spaces.

- Experienced leader with a proven ability to build, develop, and inspire high-performing, cross-functional teams.

- Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership and Board-level audiences.

- Strong commercial, financial, and analytical mindset, balancing guest experience, operational feasibility, timelines, and investment.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented copywriter to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys for a temporary contract of 6 months, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

We are seeking a highly skilled and Gen-AI savvy copywriter to shape how our brand is experienced through language. This role is central to delivering a refined, consistent, and emotionally resonant brand voice across all guest touchpoints—from digital platforms to in-suite experiences and global campaigns.

Your Impact

- Creative copywriting and storytelling: Craft compelling, elegant, and brand-aligned copy across all channels. Write high-quality editorial content such as brand stories, destination narratives, and hospitality experiences.

- Precise editing: Translate complex hospitality offerings into clear, emotionally engaging messaging that elevates perceived value. A talent to make the long or unclear: short, simple and impactful, ensuring every word reflects the sophistication, warmth, and exclusivity expected in a luxury hospitality environment. Ability to edit across differentiated channels and large volumes of copy.

- Proofreading: proofread and refine all copy to ensure grammatical accuracy, luxury vocabulary and articulation and stylistic consistency.

- Tone of Voice: maintain a consistent luxury brand tone of voice across multiple assets. Continuously evolve copy frameworks, messaging guidelines, and tone-of-voice documentation

- AI amplification to deliver scale and speed: use AI tools (e.g. generative writing assistants) to enhance brainstorming, editing, efficiency, and scale while maintaining impeccable human taste and judgment to ensure all copy meets brand editorial standards.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

- 5+ years of professional copywriting experience within luxury or luxury travel/hospitality

- Excellent storytelling skills, with a refined aesthetic sensibility and understanding of luxury brand positioning. A strong portfolio demonstrating sophisticated, persuasive, and brand-sensitive copy

- Demonstrated flexibility to adapt tone for different audiences (e.g. B2B vs B2C) and different channels (e.g. Press releases vs. Customer Service FAQs vs In-suite letters, with proven experience writing for digital platforms) while maintaining brand integrity

- Proven experience prompting AI tools across ideation, content creation, and editing to augment capacity and increase output, while keeping strong editorial judgment over final copy

- Familiarity with GEO & SEO copywriting principles

- Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence

Your Essentials

- Native English speaker a non-negotiable must, native British English speaker preferred

- Exceptional command of English writing, editing, and proofreading

- Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment

- Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation

- Deep appreciation for luxury hospitality, travel experiences, and high-end service culture. Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever evolving and luxury travel industry

- Self-learner, continuously testing and learning with creative technologies and AI-assisted workflows

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented copywriter to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys for a temporary contract of 6 months, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

We are seeking a highly skilled and Gen-AI savvy copywriter to shape how our brand is experienced through language. This role is central to delivering a refined, consistent, and emotionally resonant brand voice across all guest touchpoints—from digital platforms to in-suite experiences and global campaigns.

Your Impact

- Creative copywriting and storytelling: Craft compelling, elegant, and brand-aligned copy across all channels. Write high-quality editorial content such as brand stories, destination narratives, and hospitality experiences.

- Precise editing: Translate complex hospitality offerings into clear, emotionally engaging messaging that elevates perceived value. A talent to make the long or unclear: short, simple and impactful, ensuring every word reflects the sophistication, warmth, and exclusivity expected in a luxury hospitality environment. Ability to edit across differentiated channels and large volumes of copy.

- Proofreading: proofread and refine all copy to ensure grammatical accuracy, luxury vocabulary and articulation and stylistic consistency.

- Tone of Voice: maintain a consistent luxury brand tone of voice across multiple assets. Continuously evolve copy frameworks, messaging guidelines, and tone-of-voice documentation

- AI amplification to deliver scale and speed: use AI tools (e.g. generative writing assistants) to enhance brainstorming, editing, efficiency, and scale while maintaining impeccable human taste and judgment to ensure all copy meets brand editorial standards.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

- 5+ years of professional copywriting experience within luxury or luxury travel/hospitality

- Excellent storytelling skills, with a refined aesthetic sensibility and understanding of luxury brand positioning. A strong portfolio demonstrating sophisticated, persuasive, and brand-sensitive copy

- Demonstrated flexibility to adapt tone for different audiences (e.g. B2B vs B2C) and different channels (e.g. Press releases vs. Customer Service FAQs vs In-suite letters, with proven experience writing for digital platforms) while maintaining brand integrity

- Proven experience prompting AI tools across ideation, content creation, and editing to augment capacity and increase output, while keeping strong editorial judgment over final copy

- Familiarity with GEO & SEO copywriting principles

- Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence

Your Essentials

- Native English speaker a non-negotiable must, native British English speaker preferred

- Exceptional command of English writing, editing, and proofreading

- Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment

- Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation

- Deep appreciation for luxury hospitality, travel experiences, and high-end service culture. Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever evolving and luxury travel industry

- Self-learner, continuously testing and learning with creative technologies and AI-assisted workflows

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.
